description: Deploy server-side game logic (JS source) for a room so it runs AUTHORITATIVELY: clients send inputs and the server computes state on a tick (anti-cheat by construction). Define handlers as functions over a global `state` (RoomStateView shape): onJoin(id), onLeave(id), onInput(id, input), onEvent(id, type, data), onTick(dt); emit(type,data)/emitTo(id,type,data) send events to clients. For TRUSTWORTHY persistence the client can't fake, call saveData(id, patch)/loadData(id) (the player's server-only save) and submitScore(id, board, score, mode), the server decides the values (the client passes its identity via MP.join({…, player})). Each deploy returns a version (roll back with rollback_room_logic; read runtime errors with get_room_logs). Limits: code <= 256KB, tickRate 1-60. The code runs in a locked-down isolate: handlers must be SYNCHRONOUS (no async/await/promises/timers), there is no network or require, console.* is a no-op, and state must stay JSON-serializable (no Map/Set/class instances). Call get_sdk_reference for the full contract.

code.description: JS source defining onJoin/onLeave/onInput/onEvent/onTick over a global `state`. Or, for a long file, pass uploadId instead.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

roomName.description: The room name to make authoritative.

uploadId.description: Instead of code: the uploadId of a .js file you created with create_upload (for this game) and PUT with curl. For logic too long to send inline.
